item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 03/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring very hot weather to southern China tomorrow. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong early next week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea next week.

Date/Month: 04/06 (Sunday)
Wind: East to southeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine. One or two showers. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 29 - 34 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
